claim_text: In 2023, public transport accounted for 28.4% of all average-weekday person trips made by Merefield District residents.
source_text: 2023 Household Travel Survey — Merefield District. On an average weekday, public transport accounted for 28.4% of all person trips made by district residents. The denominator includes trips by all listed modes, and each trip is counted once by its primary mode.
evidence_quote: On an average weekday, public transport accounted for 28.4% of all person trips made by district residents.
metric_definition: Share of all average-weekday person trips made by district residents, with each trip counted once by its primary mode.
verification_rationale: The source states the same percentage, time basis, population, and transport mode as the claim.
